Licchavis
------------------------------------------
The लिच्छविस्, often mentioned in Buddhist works and even by कौटिल्य (300 B. C.) in his अर्थशास्त्र, were a powerful tribe of kṣattriyas belonging to the वसिष्ठ गोत्र (lineage). Their capital was at Vaiśāli or Vesāli. They were one of the partners in the Vajjian confederacy. Theirs was a republican form of Government.
Though they were good in trade and commerce and hence quite prosperous, they lived a hard and austere life. In course of time, luxury crept into their life making them a soft nation.
Their civilisation was of a high standard and refinement. Candragupta, the first, and Samudragupta (5th century A. D.) had married Licchavi princesses.
The लिच्छविस् had ruled Nepal also for some time.
